text:
Write the Meridian work plan for 24 modules: cache, tenant, checkout, ledger, search, shipping, sync, export, pricing, billing, alerts, gateway, notify, archive, backup, profile, audit, auth, webhooks, quota, media, indexer, reports, inventory. Final values only; earlier drafts withdrawn.

Values: tenant.timeout_s=70(client), checkout.timeout_s=70, backup.timeout_s=110, pricing.timeout_s=120, indexer.timeout_s=55, shipping.timeout_s=30, shipping.ttl_s=450, export.ttl_s=480, media.ttl_s=600, audit.max_workers=8, ledger.max_workers=16, archive.batch_size=900, inventory.queue_depth=490, billing.queue_depth=270, pricing.queue_depth=250, reports.retry_limit=8(client).

Limits (all apply): indexer.batch_size≤200, profile.ttl_s≥540, profile.batch_size≥900, gateway.max_workers≥28, media.queue_depth≤10, tenant.retry_limit≤2, auth.ttl_s≤60, sync.queue_depth≥480.

Deps: tenant→archive, auth→search, auth→shipping, gateway→search, webhooks→media, notify→audit, profile→inventory, billing→inventory.
Forbidden (transitive too): reports→notify, quota→gateway, archive→sync, indexer→auth.
Order: alerts→webhooks, billing→tenant, audit→sync, gateway→cache.
Workers: alpha{tenant,indexer}, beta{billing}, gamma{search,webhooks}, delta{notify,reports,profile}.
Co-locate: tenant+checkout, inventory+shipping, backup+quota, billing+media. Separate: backup+media, auth+cache, alerts+archive, indexer+shipping.
Files: rules.py→sync, bench.py→media, specs.py→inventory, guard.py+flags.py→audit, client.py→quota, forms.py→webhooks, views.py→reports.

Team decides: cache batch_size (~800), naming, rewrites. Parked: shared metrics library. Export DB: leaning no. Ledger on alpha preferred, optional.
